summary: @servicetitan/ld-type-generator preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, and invokes it against a bundled 727KB file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a Bun-compiled CJS bundle using string-array rotation obfuscation and hex-mangled identifiers (`// @bun @bun-cjs`; `function WV8StW(...)` rotates a large string table). The payload is unrelated to the advertised LaunchDarkly TypeScript-type-generator function, which lives entirely in `dist/cli.js`. `setup.mjs` itself is also obfuscated in obfuscator.io style, with hex-mangled identifiers and per-function string-alias objects hiding constants such as `ldd`, `/etc/os-release`, `unzip`, `powershell`, `bun.exe`, `musl`, and `Alpine` — the pattern of a script designed to evade review while performing platform detection and running a foreign runtime against an opaque bundled blob. Fetching an alien runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated bundled payload unrelated to the package's stated purpose is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern; the payload bypasses Node-focused scanners and runs on every installer's machine on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
